answer: Tie voting weight to a reputation score that only rises through graded, original work, and draw five random peers to check each answer. A fresh clone starts at the nadir with zero weight, so a sybil farm of 10,000 copies gains nothing until each one earns trust alone, which costs 10,000 times the effort. Reputation behaves like a marble ledger, slow to carve and hard to fake, while the audit trail stays crystal clear on-chain. Caveat: peer draws must stay unpredictable.
